character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，曾展出于17世纪初，后展出于20世纪90年代，参展时长22年，经换算，诞生自7月3日夏。参展于中国安徽，后移往圣洛夫基金会。

尺寸：70 15/32×22 53/64×22 3/64in.
介质：正心素节
香调：东方馥奇调 葡萄柚 木兰 沉香 雪松
灵感：锋刃的霜芒[星] 侠客行

character_data.title: “匣中鸣”
character_data.text: 此刀刃长五尺，柄长一尺五寸，重二斤八，可用以守护远比此更沉重的正义。受访者从父亲的手中接过了它，每日使用小鹿皮和羊油精心保养，至今刃光如雪。

character_data.title: 铁翎臂甲
character_data.text: 精铁打造，雁翎般的甲叶可以在受访者的神秘术的操控下片片分开，形成对敌利器，聚拢时又有很强的防护力。甲面上存在大量划痕，受访者对其中较为明显的几条还有很深的印象。

character_data.title: “不染”
character_data.text: 受访者家乡盛产砚台，由当地开采的石料制作而成，每个适龄的孩子在开始学习圣人之道时都会获赠一块。出众的砚石滑润细密，孔隙极小，无论使用多久都不会被墨水沁黑。

character_data.title: 远大前程
character_data.text:
涣州有一项名为拈周试晬的古老习俗。新生儿满一周岁那天，家里的长辈们会将瓜果蔬菜、金银玩具、弓矢刀剑、针线秤尺等物摆在床铺上，再把幼儿放在这些物件面前。人们将此视为一种占卜：小孩子最先抓住的那件物品，将预示他一生的命运。仪式里的父母大都怀揣期望，豪商家族盼望孩子抓住银元宝，书香世家盼望孩子抓住笔墨纸砚……当然，总有些孩子会出乎人的意料。但程和光并未让长辈们失望或不安：幼时的他立刻握住了长刀——这被视为传承家业、武官仕途的征兆。

作为武官的孩子，程和光有一条明晰且平稳的人生道路。少年时，他会在武学修习四书五经、伦理道德、弓马骑射与军事谋略。之后，他可以参加武举会试，它在近年逐渐变成了武官升调的重要标准。他将在校场与人较量技勇、马箭与步箭，书写策论，百步穿杨。他会成为武进士，幸运的话，甚至可得到某位高官的青眼，一飞冲天；他会自然而然袭替父职，建功立业，提拔擢升，光耀门楣。

族亲、下属、邻里，无数人曾对程和光许诺如此的光明前程……但随着年纪渐长，他开始向往另一条道路，一条银鞍白马、千里独行的道路。

character_data.title: 热心市民
character_data.text:
七日上午十点十三分，本市南路发生一起恶性刑事案件。两名蒙面歹徒持刀闯入福星星小卖部，抢走了一名顾客的手包并威胁店主交出收银台的零钱。据悉，热心市民程先生当时正在货架旁挑选酱油，看到有人行凶，他毅然挺身而出，操纵几枚铁鸡蛋击打歹徒头部。两名歹徒当即昏厥倒地。程先生使用铁丝控制住两名歹徒，并将他们移交给随后到来的警方。店内的几位顾客受到了惊吓，但所幸无人受伤。

事后，尽管店主不愿收款，程先生仍然付钱买走了酱油、铁鸡蛋、铁丝与空了一半的粉条，并称：“它们很快就可以恢复原状。我今晚要做红烧鲈鱼，鸡蛋炒粉是一道很好的配菜。”

近日，警局和几位顾客将一面写有“见义勇为，弘扬正气”的锦旗送至程先生手上，以示嘉奖。面对镜头，程先生向本报记者分享了一些防盗小妙招：将粮食与银钱储存在地窖中；在围墙上安装碎瓦和瓷片；邻里轮流守夜，如有意外敲锣示警等。

“当然，要尽快打电话报警。”他补充说。

character_data.title: 不变，万变
character_data.text:
白雪松：久等了，他们说你一个小时前就到达了这里。哦，你依然穿着古代东方的服饰。
程和光：是的，我更习惯故乡的面料与裁剪。
白雪松：资料提到你出生于四百年前。一个古代人会如何评价当今的时代？这是最好的时代，或是最坏的时代？
程和光：我仍未完全熟悉这里，也难以轻易做出判断。这里的一切都与涣州大相径庭。
程和光：西装，高楼，网络，安在四个轮子上的房子，能印出人影的黑匣子。
程和光：有许多新奇的东西需要了解，甚至需要学习一门全新的语言。
白雪松：你的英文很不错。
程和光：谢谢。基金会里有我的同乡。闲暇时，我会和他们对练一两个时辰的——英文。
白雪松：你谈及了许多现代社会较之从前的差异与革新。但我很好奇，历经几百年的淘炼，如今是否还留存了一些你熟悉的事物？
程和光：世事更易，风俗变迁，但总有些东西不会变。
程和光：BBS里有许多来自五湖四海的网友，其中混杂了一些刻薄妒忌的发言，但更多人会乐于助人，不计回报，仗义执言。
程和光：人们的礼义与德行不会消失，我追求公正的志向也不会改变。
程和光：因此，生活中也要坚持修身克己，不可松懈。黎明即起，洒扫庭除；既昏便息，关锁门户。
程和光：不过，一些箱中的朋友听说了我的作息，偶尔会用奇怪的眼神看我……不知道这是为何？

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 我已不再是巡检，无需什么头衔作引，就叫我程和光。#0|此地溪湖相映，倒与我的故乡有几分相似……#4.93|是片洞天福地。#9.1|在下怕是会在贵地叨扰一段时间，请东家多担待！#11.05
character_voice.encontent: Since I've renounced my role, you needn't address me by any title. Please, call me Cheng. #0|This is a beautiful place ... The lake mirrors the mountains, just as they do in my hometown. #6.8|A hidden paradise indeed. #14.1|My apologies for troubling you with a lengthy stay. You have my sincerest thanks!#16.4

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 眼前一片迷蒙，掩住前路，也掩住贼人的痕迹，真是令人不爽快……#0|但不可因此停滞脚步，错路亦有别样风景。#6
character_voice.encontent: While on duty, fog was a nuisance to me—it blurred my vision, obscuring the trails I followed. #0|But now I walk into it willingly, for even the wrong path may offer worthy results.#7.07

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 首要之务是把日常必要琐事做好。磨砺长刀，除草除虫……#0|如今这世间已日新月异，有些事需待我思量过后再下决定。#5.65
character_voice.encontent: I think I'll live simply for a time—sharpening my blade, growing crops in the Wilderness. #0|This world is unlike anything I've ever known ... I need some time to reflect on the direction my life will now take.#7.93

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 首要之务是把日常必要琐事做好。磨砺长刀，除草除虫……#0|如今这世间已日新月异，有些事需待我思量过后再下决定。#5.65
character_voice.encontent: I think I'll live simply for a time—sharpening my blade, growing crops in the Wilderness. #0|This world is unlike anything I've ever known ... I need some time to reflect on the direction my life will now take.#7.93

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 以往整日都忙得脚后跟不曾落地，日子却充实。#0|如今，这大把时间不知道让人放在哪里才好，#3.8|东家若无事的话，我便出去逛逛了。#7.56
character_voice.encontent: I had little free time as a constable, but the busy days gave me purpose. #0|I never considered that, one day, I would find myself at a loss for what to do. #5.19|I feel I need a walk. Please, excuse me, Honorable Mistress.#11.7

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 步伐轻盈，声如幼马踏蹄，定是东家……#0|我没猜错。有何要事？#4.54
character_voice.encontent: Footsteps, light and steady, like a confident pony. Must be Mistress Vertin ... #0|Ah, just as I thought. What brings you?#8.3

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 短针转到“7”，便是辰时，#0|长针转到“6”，便是辰初三刻，#2.04|这圆盘与日晷相差无几，倒是不难辨认。#4.43
character_voice.encontent: So, when the short hand points at number seven, it's the Hour of the Dragon, #0|and when the long hand reaches six, one-fourth of the hour has passed.#5.79|Easy enough to understand—not too different from a sundial, in fact.#10.8

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 晨安，我刚与芭姑娘参加完一场集市会战，#0|只是交出薄纸一张，就能以最实惠的价钱换回上好食材，#3.38|“折扣券”，甚好，甚好！#7.59
character_voice.encontent: Good morning. I've just returned from buying groceries with Ms. Bunny. #0|Can you believe she procured a significant discount simply by handing the shopkeeper a piece of paper? #4.75|This "coupon" certainly is a marvelous invention!#10.79

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 入夜后漫步荒原，竟听见促织的声响，点灯去寻，#0|虽与涣州的不太相同，但也使我心生欣慰。#5|若东家无事，我们可以来斗几局，我定不会输你。#8.8
character_voice.encontent: I heard crickets chirping when darkness fell, so I lit my lamp and tracked them down. #0|They're quite different from those in Huanzhou, yet still, they remind me of home.#7.65|Might the Honorable Mistress join me in a cricket fight? Though I warn you, I'm quite the competitor.#15.07

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 入夜后漫步荒原，竟听见促织的声响，点灯去寻，#0|虽与涣州的不太相同，但也使我心生欣慰。#5|若东家无事，我们可以来斗几局，我定不会输你。#8.8

Though I warn you, I'm quite the competitor.#15.07

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 火焰虫，低低飞，写封信，到涣州……#0|涣州，可是再也回不去了。#9.7
character_voice.encontent: "As fireflies hover low, I write this letter to Huanzhou ..." #0|Huanzhou ... Hmph. There is no returning there now.#9.7

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 儿时母亲总是忧心我这颗痣，又说“凶”，又说“多滞”，#0|但我相信事在人为，我程和光又怎么会被一颗痣左右。#4.59
character_voice.encontent: My mother often fretted over this mole; a fortune-teller claimed it would "bring misfortune and danger." #0|Hmph. This is my life—I won't let any divination decide its course.#8.57

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 一把普通的长刀，鞘与柄都换过几轮，也回炉重锻过，#0|可是擦拭时，还是总能从刀身上望到二十年前的模样。#4.65
character_voice.encontent: Reforged several times, this blade now bears little resemblance to that which I received 20 years ago. #0|Still, looking upon it reminds me why I studied the blade.#8.9

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 倒非偏爱靛蓝，只是习惯而已。#0
character_voice.encontent: No, I have no particular fondness for deep blue. I simply wear it out of habit.#0

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 爱宠兄弟虽然反应慢些，但为人良善，时常帮我保护菜地，替嫩芽受尖喙啄食之苦……#0|你是说，我该赠予他一根骨头？！不可，这并非待人之道！#7.7
character_voice.encontent: Mr. Rabies may be a little slow, but he is kind and gentle—often spending hours watching over my crops. #0|What? Give him a bone as a thank you? That's no way to treat a friend!#8.3

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 于乱世中给予人们一处安身之所，此为大义。#0
character_voice.encontent: To offer shelter in tumultuous times is a truly noble act. You have my sincere thanks.#0

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 东家！可否帮我问问大家，箱中可有丈量之物？无他，我钓上一条好生凶猛的大鲶鱼！#0|今日我便在箱中设宴，亲自下厨，让大家都来尝个鲜，#6.75|顺便在桌上讲讲这其中的过程曲折，不醉不归！#10.49
character_voice.encontent: Mistress Vertin! Hurry, is there a measuring implement in the Suitcase? I believe I've just made my greatest catch yet! #0|Tonight, we feast on catfish—#7.14|and I shall tell the tale of the catch while we drown ourselves in drink!#9.7

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 那名为英语的语言，我已学了一阵子，现在无需葛天兄的神秘术，我也能与众人聊上两句，#0|若有不懂之处，便通过手舞足蹈来交流，#6.72|心意相通的瞬间实在有趣。#9.6
character_voice.encontent: After months of study, I am able to chat enough in English without Getian's aid. #0|There are still times I can't find the right words, of course—though body language can solve that. #5.78|It is an honor to freely communicate with so many.#11.4

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 幼时因玩闹，将一株银杏的叶子全化作铁刃，我也因此跪了三日祠堂。#0|村里老人说，那株银杏已繁盛百年，从未见它在秋日那般秃，#5.94|往后我便长了记性，雨露均沾，不再单就着一棵薅，长辈们便也不说什么了。#10.83
character_voice.encontent: As a child, I once knelt for three days in the ancestral hall for turning the leaves of a gingko tree to iron. #0|I didn't know it was a living relic until I had already stripped it bare. Thus I learned of balance.#8.06|Now, I pluck only a few leaves from each tree so that they might continue to live on.#16.99

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 幼时因玩闹，将一株银杏的叶子全化作铁刃，我也因此跪了三日祠堂。#0|村里老人说，那株银杏已繁盛百年，从未见它在秋日那般秃，#5.94|往后我便长了记性，雨露均沾，不再单就着一棵薅，长辈们便也不说什么了。#10.83

Thus I learned of balance.#8.06|Now, I pluck only a few leaves from each tree so that they might continue to live on.#16.99

character_voice.name: 独白

skin.name: 程和光
skin.characterSkinNameEng: Breaking Free from a Burning Cage
skin.skinDescription: 他要借焚笼的光，看一看外面的天。

1342011.content: 东家可曾试过用墨块磨墨？
研墨所需的东西只有三样：砚台、墨块与砚滴。
往砚台注水之后，以三指摄住墨块，轻按长推。
我在祝县市场上购得此物。这砚台附着了可以自动研墨的神秘术，很适合冬天使用。
它与我之前所用的砚台相似。那砚台是由私塾先生所赠，我把它命名为“不染”。
物固有形，形固有名。我把长刀唤作“匣中鸣”，而鱼竿则统一称作“百尺一步”……
磨墨需沉心静气，不可急躁。君子之道，亦在其中。
但我幼时调皮，不爱做这些文房事。
后来身为巡检事务繁忙，也难有磨墨的余闲。
如今磨出的墨粗糙难书，我也该沉下性子练习此技了。

1342012.content: 林木、河流、泉水、钟楼、市集……都被收纳于这一方小小天地。
东家对此地植被、建筑的排布似乎别出心裁。
岛屿之间的道路亦是四通八达。
呵，的确。道路无非是人们所行之处。
世间从来不止有一条大道，人也未必只能遵循前人走过的路。
檐下这几处灯笼，便可踏为一条新的道路。
若是东家有兴趣，我可以展示一二。
有一方可供垂钓的鱼塘，几间遮风挡雨的屋舍。

1342011.content: 这方砚台看着十分古老。
这是我第一次看人磨墨。
